integrity: The all-N result is proved analytically; the bundled computation is corroborative. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real even polynomials with nonconstant support \(\{\pm1,\pm3\}\) on a uniform cyclic grid; it does not solve larger harmonic supports. Literature coverage may miss an equivalent older formulation under different notation.
title: Exact discrete Carathéodory–Fejér constant for the isolated third harmonic
